python-terminaltexteffects on Omarchy

A visual effects engine that animates terminal text output — think Matrix rain, but for any string.

Package data synced 2026-10-21 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install python-terminaltexteffects on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add python-terminaltexteffects. It is a 491.4 KB download (3.4 MB installed), version 0.15.0-1, licensed MIT. Visual effects engine applied to text in the terminal. Free and open source.

Install python-terminaltexteffects on Omarchy

TerminalTextEffects (TTE) is a Python library and command-line tool that adds animated visual effects to text printed in the terminal — color gradients, particle-like motion paths, Matrix-style rain, and more. It ships 40+ built-in effects, usable either by piping text into the CLI application or by calling it as a library from your own scripts, with no third-party Python dependencies required.

Watch: 「TerminalTextEffects」のエフェクト集 ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add python-terminaltexteffects
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.15.0-1:
    pacman -Qi python-terminaltexteffects

Open and use python-terminaltexteffects

python-terminaltexteffects has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql python-terminaltexteffects | grep /usr/bin/

python-terminaltexteffects requirements and compatibility

  • A terminal that supports Xterm 256 or RGB hex colors

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • python

Free and open source. License: MIT.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install python-terminaltexteffects on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add python-terminaltexteffects. The download is 491.4 KB and it takes 3.4 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is python-terminaltexteffects free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall python-terminaltexteffects?

Run omarchy pkg drop python-terminaltexteffects. It removes the package from your system.

What does python-terminaltexteffects depend on?

The package declares 1 dependency: python. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is python-terminaltexteffects a desktop app?

No. python-terminaltexteffects has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is python-terminaltexteffects in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as python-terminaltexteffects (version 0.15.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. ChrisBuilds makes it.
